To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) scripted GUI testing is not a widely adopted practice for Android apps, (ii) test suites are often modified, and (iii) a relevant amount of modifications (60% on the average) is due to fragility.

1) GUI testing of Android applications is not widespread, 2) test classes have to be updated often to keep them up to date, 3) a significant amount of modifications to test classes is due to GUI test class fragility, 4) the amount of fragility-induced changes depends on the GUI testing framework used.
GUI test suites for Android applications suffer from fragility, which is a major obstacle to the diffusion of automated scripted GUI testing of Android apps.
